title: Expected hitting time
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a finite vertex type, with positive natural-number degree $D$. For vertices $t$ and $s$ and a natural number $N$, the hit time from $s$ to $t$ up to time $N$ is the sum of the miss probabilities at times $j=0,1,nothing,N-1$ for the walk on $G$ from $s$ relative to target $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite vertex type with decidable equality
A regular multigraph on the vertex type
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of the miss probability or its walk convention, so that part of the interpretation cannot be fully checked.
